description: [narrowed from route-edit-c1b118e0] In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/rhythm-conductor-tick.ts, inside the drainBoredomQueue function, there is a line that reads: if (res) { (t as { status?: string }).status = "dispatched"; dispatched += 1; }. The response object res is returned by the POST to run-goal and carries a dispatchId, but that identifier is currently discarded, so a queue task records that it dispatched without recording what it dispatched and cannot be joined to any execution. Extend that single statement so it also stores the dispatchId from res onto the task object alongside the status. Do not add any import. Do not modify any other line or any other function. The change must typecheck.
